investigation_summary: Customer Adebayo O. Adeyemi (CUST-UK-015201) is a PEP who made five structured cash deposits totalling £48,600 on consecutive days, all below the £10,000 reporting threshold, followed immediately by a £48,000 SWIFT transfer to the UAE, a FATF grey-listed jurisdiction. Transaction volumes are inconsistent with the subject's declared salary income of £48,000.

false_positive_hypotheses_considered.hypothesis: The cash deposits represent accumulated legitimate savings being consolidated
false_positive_hypotheses_considered.reason: Five deposits on consecutive days in amounts just below £10,000 is inconsistent with savings consolidation and is consistent with deliberate structuring to avoid reporting thresholds.

false_positive_hypotheses_considered.hypothesis: The international transfer is a legitimate business payment
false_positive_hypotheses_considered.reason: Customer is an individual salaried employee with no business accounts. The payment reference 'Consultancy Fees' is inconsistent with their declared occupation as a Business Development Manager.

key_evidence.data_point: 5 CASH_DEPOSIT transactions on consecutive days: £9,800, £9,650, £9,900, £9,750, £9,500 — all below £10,000 threshold, totalling £48,600
key_evidence.significance: Classic structuring pattern — amounts deliberately kept below the £10,000 reporting threshold across 5 consecutive in-branch deposits
key_evidence.finding: 5 CASH_DEPOSIT transactions on consecutive days totalling £48,600
key_evidence.regulatory_significance: Violates POCA 2002 s.327 — structuring to avoid reporting thresholds
key_evidence.statistical_context: £48,600 structured total represents 101.25% of declared annual income of £48,000

key_evidence.data_point: SWIFT transfer of £48,000 to UAE (FATF grey-listed) on 2024-11-08, 3 days after the cash deposits cleared
key_evidence.significance: Rapid outflow to a FATF grey-listed jurisdiction immediately following structured cash receipt — consistent with placement and layering phases
key_evidence.finding: £48,000 SWIFT transfer to UAE 3 days after structured deposits
key_evidence.regulatory_significance: Violates FATF Recommendation 19 — transfer to FATF grey-listed jurisdiction
key_evidence.statistical_context: £48,000 outflow represents 79.2% of total credits of £60,600 in the observation window

key_evidence.data_point: Customer pep_flag=True — son of State Governor Oluwasegun Adeyemi. kyc_status: ENHANCED_DUE_DILIGENCE, risk_rating: HIGH
key_evidence.significance: Any suspicious activity on a PEP account requires mandatory escalation under MLR 2017 Reg. 35 regardless of transaction amounts
key_evidence.finding: Customer is a PEP — son of State Governor
key_evidence.regulatory_significance: Mandatory escalation under MLR 2017 Reg. 35 for PEP accounts
key_evidence.statistical_context: Total flagged amount of £387,500 represents 807% of declared annual income of £48,000
